Onnihom — Singapore & beyond

The good stuff is being made two streets away.

Onnihom is a free, independent directory of home-based businesses — bakers, tailors, artisans, and quiet masters of craft — including many who have no website or social media of their own. Step inside to find and support a home-based business near you.

Found a hidden gem with no signal nearby?

Onnihom works offline too — capture a lead out in the field and it sends automatically once you're back online.
